subject: general
question:
Observe the bar graph and answer the question below.

The total annual earnings of a family of four members is Rs. 12 lakhs. The bar graph shows the percentage of contribution of each family member.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57c5a701af75c0f51b48df3f8f115d2f0f1abb49b1e3b2d895b4b43c503c1737.png] 

What is the difference in the salary of the highest and the lowest earning members?
solution:
**Calculations:**

Highest salary = 33% of 1200000

Lowest salary = 20% of 1200000

Difference in height & lowest salary = 33% of 1200000 – 20% of 1200000

⇒ 13% of 1200000

⇒ 156000 Rupees

**∴ The correct choice is option 4.**
